detail.longDescription: 💁🏻‍♀️ TIL: 🐛🌊 Scientists have long wondered why no # insects live in the # ocean , often blaming # water pressure. A new # study found that # larvae of the lake fly Chaoborus edulis dive nearly 260 m in # LakeMalawi using stretchy air sacs powered by the # protein # resilin .
